items.note: Verified at cb8c2e07ab041fd7b2a826bd04cdb2e0130ab5ab. Every rule message in tests/lab.mjs now names the file and the unmet rule (for example "only the wrapper files and pom.xml may be copied before the dependency download", "the build context still sends N kind(s) of file it must leave out", "the api datasource URL must reach the database by its service name and container port"). None gives a COPY/RUN template, image tag line, ignore entry, jdbc template, variable name to use or pg_isready line; I reviewed every return string in the file. They restate the README phase 3 outcomes, which are the spec. README Phase 1 and Phase 4 wording now matches. Starter output matches expected/starter-summary.txt exactly. Both private solutions pass 20/20 and match expected/solved-summary.txt.

Troubleshooting now uses the neutral form some-key: "docker compose <subcommand> <options>" and no runbook answer. The runbook messages describe the need ("keep running in the background after the command returns", "list every container ... including the ones that have exited", "what the api service alone has written so far, then return", "print exactly one named variable"), not the subcommand or flag. The README table was already need-phrased.

Rerun of my probe script on a completed copy, with the HEAD rules. Now accepted: "docker compose logs api -f", "docker compose -f compose.yaml up -d", "docker container run -d --env-file .env postgres:18", --env-file=.env, logs --tail 50 api, and an echo of one variable through sh -c. Now rejected: "docker compose up -d db", docker run without detach, an attached -ePOSTGRES_PASSWORD=..., exec api env, logs without a service, foreground up, and a chained up -d && ps. README phase 5 now says which forms are understood. The author's private bypass suite, run from my copy against the HEAD rules, catches 59/59.

All starter TODO markers (backend/Dockerfile, frontend/Dockerfile, both .dockerignore files, compose.yaml, .gitignore) and fixtures/.env.example now point to "README phase 3, <file heading>", which matches the README headings. runbook.yaml already pointed to phase 5. A grep of the lab finds no "README step" left.

README Timing now begins "Authoring estimate, not a measured learner pilot: about 87 minutes". The split S36 42 (setup 3 + 5 + 10 + 12 + 8 + 4) and S37 45 (18 + 15 + 12) reproduces the phase sums. The per-day worst case is stated (58 and 53, both at 60 or less). coding-lab-timing.json now says 20 tests and six file groups, including runbook.yaml, with worst 111 = 58 + 53. lab.json minutes match (42, 45, 111).

The Goal now lists .env, copied from fixtures/.env.example and never committed.
